comments.name: GlobalCitizen
comments.content: The US-China summit looks promising, hopefully, it can ease global tensions. My finance prof back in NYC was always talking about sovereign debt risks, and now seeing these US bond market turmoils, it’s quite concerning. Yen's rebound is interesting, showing central bank intervention worries. And AI? Microsoft integrating Copilot into Office is a game-changer, truly making AI an 'entry point.' The competition among LLMs like Codex and Claude Code is insane, really shaping the future of work. So much innovation, but also so much uncertainty, especially with geopolitical issues like the Strait of Hormuz. It's a complex world out there, you know? 🌍✨
